criteria.criterion: publish <version> fetches origin and finds the release commit before anything is written; none refuses `release: no release commit for <version> on origin/main — merge the release PR first` (exit 1), with no tag and no release created. Tagging before finding the release commit is a violation.
criteria.evidence: publish.go fetches then calls findReleaseCommit before any tag or gh call; publish_test.go asserts the exact message, exit 1, no tag and empty gh log, including a decoy commit

criteria.criterion: It creates the annotated tag <version> on the release commit (not origin/main's tip), message `<version>: <brief titles joined by "; ">` from the briefs of `notes <previous version tag> <release commit>`, or `<version>` alone without briefs, and pushes it. A tag already on that commit is kept; one elsewhere refuses `release: tag <version> points at <sha>, not the release commit <sha>` (exit 1), leaving the tag as it was.
criteria.evidence: publish.go git tag -a on rc with joined titles, push; test checks tag commit, message 'v0.12.0: the alpha' and bare 'v0.12.1-rc.1', and the elsewhere refusal leaves the tag

criteria.criterion: It runs `gh release create <version> --verify-tag`, titled <version>, with `notes <previous version tag> <version>` as the notes, and --prerelease for a version with a -<pre> suffix. An existing release is kept.
criteria.evidence: publish.go cargs and gh release view check; test asserts gh args for release and pre-release

criteria.criterion: On success stdout ends with exactly the brief's four lines: `published <version>: <release url>`, `install: go install github.com/mvelosop/vloop/cmd/vloop@<version>`, `then, in each repository: vloop upgrade`, `and for the plugin: claude plugin marketplace update vloop && claude plugin update vloop@vloop`.
criteria.evidence: final four Fprintf lines in publish.go; test uses HasSuffix on all four

criteria.criterion: publish never pushes to main and never merges. The tool's tests use stubs for gh, go and claude on PATH and a local bare repository as origin, in temporary directories with a temporary HOME, addressed with git -C; no test runs the real gh, go install from the network, or this repository's origin.
criteria.evidence: only the tag ref is pushed; test asserts origin main unchanged; test uses prepared() with STUBS dir and a stub gh

criteria.criterion: Committed tests, run by the checks, cover the release-commit search (including a decoy subject whose plugin.json does not hold the version), the refusal before any write, the tag's commit and message, the tag elsewhere, and gh's arguments for a release and a pre-release.
criteria.evidence: TestPublish in publish_test.go covers each; go check passed per checks.json

notes: The tag-already-on-the-commit keep path and an existing release are not exercised by a test; acceptable, T7 adds the re-run.
